summary: The Sparrow's barrel roll moved off the boost button onto the right stick as a vessel dynamic no element changes (Shombith 2026-11-24), so the Time scaling on the roll's duration (rollTimeScale, x1 -> x0.5) is removed. Time still scales the Afterburner's boost speed. The Honeyguide, which carries the same BarrelRollController, now rolls on the right stick too.
